name: punch-200-stress
description: Run 200 real server-authoritative punches in five bounded batches across center, edge, corner, tunnel, rubble, and high-power conditions.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local specs={{name='center',x=-2,power=15,cycles=8,attempts=5,resetTotal=true,expectedTotal=40},{name='edge',x=18,power=6000,cycles=8,attempts=5,expectedTotal=80},{name='corner',x=20,targetX=-2,power=6000,cycles=8,attempts=5,expectedTotal=120},{name='tunnel',x=-2,power=1500000000,cycles=8,attempts=5,expectedTotal=160},{name='rubble',x=2,power=1500000000,rubble=true,cycles=8,attempts=5,expectedTotal=200}} local results={} local allValid=true for index,spec in ipairs(specs) do local result=c:Invoke('StressPunchCase',spec) local expectedPunches=spec.cycles*spec.attempts local minimumSuccess=math.ceil(expectedPunches*.925) local contractValid=type(result)=='table' and result.valid==true and result.name==spec.name and result.punches==expectedPunches and (result.success or -1)>=minimumSuccess and result.total==spec.expectedTotal and result.overlaps==0 and result.corrections==0 and result.stuck==0 and (result.maxBack or math.huge)<.5 and result.platform==false and result.sit==false and result.state~='Missing' and result.endpointMode=='DamageThenSweep' local row=type(result)=='table' and result or {name=spec.name,resultType=type(result)} row.contractValid=contractValid row.expectedPunches=expectedPunches row.expectedTotal=spec.expectedTotal results[index]=row allValid=allValid and contractValid end local finalResult=results[#results] local diagnostics={valid=allValid and #results==5 and finalResult.total==200,batches=#results,total=finalResult.total or -1,cases=results} assert(diagnostics.valid,'200-punch self-contained stress contract failed: '..H:JSONEncode(diagnostics)) return H:JSONEncode(diagnostics)

steps.label: run and positively verify five fresh batches totaling 200 punches
